verdict.rationale: Google Workspace ships extensive Admin SDK, Directory, Reports, and Cloud Identity APIs covering many administrative UI functions, plus Apps Script for automating console tasks (google-workspace-docs-1..7,14,19,22-24,30). However, community evidence shows concrete gaps where UI-configured settings (e.g., Context-Aware Access policies) cannot be introspected or debugged via API, forcing reliance on the UI (google-workspace-comm-1, google-workspace-comm-3), and there is no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to confirm full parity (google-workspace-probe-1, google-workspace-probe-2). Missing for 10: API parity for AI-feature settings (Gemini, Meet notetaking), machine-readable API discovery (OpenAPI/llms.txt), and resolution of documented CAA troubleshooting gaps.
